reviews.text: This is perfect for my mixed skin in the winter but it’s a bit sticky when I‘m using it in the summer. But I do use it with the medicube machine thing for my night routines and it works really well! This is my second bottle by the way, and I might order more
reviews.zh: 冬天用嚟，啱晒我嘅混合皮，但係夏天用就有少少黏。不過我夜晚護理時會配合 medicube 嗰部儀器用，效果好好！順帶一提，呢個係我第二支，我可能會再訂多啲。

reviews.text: I've been enjoying the Pink PDRN Light Serum, so I wanted to try this ampoule too. So far, it absorbs quickly and feels hydrating without being sticky. It's still too early to see significant results, but I haven't experienced any irritation and it feels nice on my skin. ✨
reviews.zh: 我一直好享受 Pink PDRN Light Serum，所以都想試吓呢款安瓶精華。目前為止，佢吸收好快，又唔會黏，用起嚟感覺好滋潤。現時仲未夠時間見到明顯效果，但係我冇出現任何刺激，塗喺皮膚上感覺好舒服。✨

reviews.text: Really made my skin pop with pimples. Will not purchase again
reviews.zh: 真係令我皮膚冒咗好多痘痘。我唔會再買。

reviews.text: Quick absorbing non sticky formula! I have extremely sensitive skin and I’ve had no issues! I have noticed the fine lines on my forehead going away! My skin feels firmer and more youthful! Great product if you have started to notice signs of aging!
reviews.zh: 吸收好快，唔黏嘅配方！我嘅皮膚非常敏感，但完全冇問題！我留意到額頭上嘅幼紋正在減淡！皮膚感覺更緊緻、更年輕！如果你開始留意到老化跡象，呢款產品好好！

reviews.text: Silky, gentle serum that gives my skin a noticeable boost in hydration and softness. Works well for sensitive skin, with no irritation after use. Skin looks smoother and more radiant with continued application.
reviews.zh: 絲滑溫和嘅精華，令我皮膚嘅保濕同柔軟度有明顯提升。啱敏感皮膚用，用完冇刺激。持續使用之後，皮膚睇落更加順滑、更有光澤。

reviews.text:
The Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Ampoule is a powerhouse serum that delivers impressive results for skin rejuvenation and overall radiance. The ampoule combines PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) with peptides, which work together to promote skin regeneration, improve elasticity, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.

The serum has a smooth, silky texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue. After using it consistently, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin’s firmness and hydration. My skin felt noticeably plumper and more youthful, with a healthy glow. It’s also gentle on the skin and doesn’t cause any irritation, making it suitable for sensitive skin types.

The packaging is sleek and easy to use, with a dropper that allows for precise application. Overall, the Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Ampoule is a must-try for those looking to target skin aging, enhance skin texture, and boost moisture. Highly recommended
reviews.zh:
Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Ampoule 係一款功效強勁嘅精華，對於皮膚年輕化同整體提亮，效果都好出色。呢款安瓶結合咗 PDRN（多聚脫氧核苷酸）同胜肽，兩者一齊作用，促進皮膚再生、改善彈性，並減淡細紋同皺紋。

呢款精華質地順滑、絲滑，皮膚吸收好快，冇留低油膩感。我持續使用之後，發覺皮膚嘅緊緻度同水分都有明顯改善。皮膚感覺明顯飽滿咗，亦更年輕，有健康光澤。佢對皮膚都溫和，唔會引起任何刺激，所以適合敏感肌膚。

包裝簡約時尚，易於使用，附有滴管，可以精準塗抹。整體嚟講，Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Ampoule 係一款必試產品，適合想針對皮膚老化、改善膚質同提升保濕嘅人。強烈推薦。

reviews.text:
I usually avoid all products with fragrance because my skin can find it irritating - I have quite sensitive skin-, but I missed it on this ingredients list. I'd already purchased it and had it, so I decided to try it. I've been using it every day since and haven't experienced any irritation, the scent is there but it's not in any way overwhelming. The pink colour of the serum quickly fades away as it's spread.
It leaves me with a healthy glow and revitalized looking skin
reviews.zh:
我平時都會避開所有有香味嘅產品，因為我嘅皮膚可能會覺得刺激（我皮膚幾敏感），但係我漏咗睇成分表入面嘅香料。我已經買咗，又有咗呢支，所以決定試吓。之後我每日都用，都冇出現任何刺激，香味有，但絕對唔會令人覺得太濃烈。精華嘅粉紅色塗開之後好快就淡去。
佢令我皮膚有健康光澤，睇落煥發咗。

reviews.text: The essence has a pleasant, a bit slippery texture and no scent. My combination skin absorbs it quite quickly without any residue. Gently exfoliating with moisturization, this product effectively eliminates dead skin cells and regulates sebum production without causing irritation. Moreover, it deeply hydrates dry skin, and since it's made from natural ingredients, it can be safely used on sensitive skin without any irritation. The brand prioritises skin health and safety, using gentle and non-irritating ingredients that are suitable for even the most sensitive and acne-prone skin types.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華質地好舒服，有少少滑，冇香味。我嘅混合皮吸收得幾快，冇任何殘留。呢款產品溫和去角質兼保濕，有效清除死皮細胞，又可以調節皮脂分泌，唔會引起刺激。而且，佢可以深層滋潤乾性皮膚；因為係用天然成分製造，所以可以安全地用喺敏感皮膚上，唔會有任何刺激。呢個品牌好重視皮膚健康同安全，用嘅係溫和、不刺激嘅成分，適合甚至係最敏感同易生暗瘡嘅膚質。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
